query: SELECT rc.id, rc.name, LEFT(rc.streamUrl, 60) as rc_url, LEFT(ss.stream_url, 60) as ss_url FROM radio_channels rc JOIN streaming_status ss ON ss.channel_id = rc.id WHERE rc.id IN (2, 9, 17, 21);
